purpose: Primary collection discovery and source links. A public catalogue is not a blanket media reuse licence.

institutions.name: Video Game History Foundation
institutions.access: Public ArchivesSpace catalogue and public digital archive. Some holdings are not catalogued or digitised.
institutions.api_status: No supported public bulk API verified during this bounded audit.
institutions.media_reuse: Rights must be checked for the individual magazine, recording, artwork or document. No blanket download permission inferred.

records.title: Computer Gaming World
records.date_semantics: Publication range of the collection, including successor Games for Windows: The Official Magazine; not a single title's uninterrupted publication range.
records.story_relevance: Contemporary reviews, advertisements and letters can show how computer-game audiences and business expectations changed. Reference individual issues after checking rights.

records.title: Computer Game Developers' Conference 1989 talk recordings
records.verification: Official collection page title verified; no individual recording metadata or media rights imported.
records.story_relevance: Developers speaking to their peers provide first-person evidence about craft and working conditions.

records.title: Michael Shorrock Sega Channel collection
records.verification: Official featured collection link; item contents, precise date range and rights require item-level inspection.

records.title: GamePro press CD collection
records.verification: Official featured collection link; no original press assets have been reproduced or treated as freely licensed.

institutions.name: Computerspielemuseum Berlin
institutions.api_status: No public item-level collection API verified. Holdings figures are explicitly the institution's 2022 snapshot.
institutions.story_relevance: A museum opening and its preservation network are part of the medium's cultural history; its collection can guide research into surviving hardware and original exhibits.
institutions.media_reuse: Institutional website images are not assumed free to reuse. Separately licensed Commons photographs require their own creator, licence and original-vs-reconstruction caption.

institutions.name: ACMI
institutions.coverage_note: Physical holdings and public database coverage are different. Do not claim 7000 downloadable game records.
institutions.date_semantics: first_production_date is a collection claim and may differ from first public release. Research seeds are not safe chronology dates without review.
institutions.metadata_license: CC0 for the official JSON collection metadata; TSV is the documented spreadsheet representation of those records.
institutions.media_reuse: Images and videos are not licensed by the metadata CC0 statement. No images were selected or downloaded by this adapter.
institutions.software_note: No ACMI API software was copied; the adapter reads the institution's documented metadata export.
